title: 2-Pad SMD Resistor Breakout PCB
description: Minimal 2-layer KiCad 8 PCB layout with a 0603 SMD resistor, 2-pin power header, FR4 stackup, copper routing, and closed Edge.Cuts board outline.
code:
(kicad_pcb
  (version 20240108)
  (generator "pcbnew")
  (layers
    (0 "F.Cu" signal)
    (31 "B.Cu" signal)
    (44 "Edge.Cuts" user)
  )
  (setup
    (stackup
      (layer "F.Cu" (type "copper") (thickness 0.035))
      (layer "dielectric 1" (type "core") (thickness 1.53) (material "FR4") (epsilon_r 4.3) (loss_tangent 0.02))
      (layer "B.Cu" (type "copper") (thickness 0.035))
    )
  )
  (net 0 "")
  (net 1 "VCC")
  (net 2 "GND")
  (footprint "Resistor_SMD:R_0603_1608Metric"
    (layer "F.Cu")
    (at 15 10)
    (property "Reference" "R1")
    (property "Value" "10k")
    (property "MPN" "RC0603FR-0710KL")
    (pad "1" smd roundrect (at -0.8 0) (size 0.9 0.95) (layers "F.Cu" "F.Mask") (net 1 "VCC"))
    (pad "2" smd roundrect (at 0.8 0) (size 0.9 0.95) (layers "F.Cu" "F.Mask") (net 2 "GND"))
  )
  (footprint "Connector_PinHeader:PinHeader_1x02"
    (layer "F.Cu")
    (at 25 10)
    (property "Reference" "J1")
    (property "Value" "PWR")
    (pad "1" thru_hole circle (at 0 0) (size 1.7 1.7) (drill 1.0) (layers "*.Cu" "*.Mask") (net 1 "VCC"))
    (pad "2" thru_hole circle (at 0 2.54) (size 1.7 1.7) (drill 1.0) (layers "*.Cu" "*.Mask") (net 2 "GND"))
  )
  (gr_rect (start 0 0) (end 35 20) (layer "Edge.Cuts") (width 0.1))
  (segment (start 14.2 10) (end 25 10) (width 0.25) (layer "F.Cu") (net 1))
  (segment (start 15.8 10) (end 25 12.54) (width 0.25) (layer "B.Cu") (net 2))
  (via (at 18 10) (size 0.6) (drill 0.3) (layers "F.Cu" "B.Cu") (net 2))
)
